text:
Predicates:
PublishingHouse(x) ::: x is a publishing house.
SpecializeIn(x, y) ::: x specializes in y.
Translate(x, y, z) ::: x translates y into z.
Published(x, y) ::: x published y.
Language(x, y) ::: x is in language y.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Premises:
PublishingHouse(newVesselPress) ∧ ∀x (Published(newVesselPress, x) → Language(x, english)) ::: New Vessel Press is a publishing house which specializes in translating foreign literature into English. All of New Vessel Press's published books are in English.
Published(newVesselPress, neapolitanChronicles) ∧ Translate(neapolitanChronicles, italian, english) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is a book published by New Vessel Press. Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
Published(newVesselPress, palaceOfFlies) ::: Palace of Flies is a book published by New Vessel Press.
Conclusion:
Translate(palaceOfFlies, italian, english) ::: Palace of Flies was translated from Italian.
